notes: The relay/PTC starter (QP2-4.7H or JPQII-4.7) and the overload protector (DRB21R61A1 or BT62-120) have alternates, so a given unit may carry either. The product has been discontinued.

gaps: The parts web page shows the same part numbers and names except the compressor and compressor base, and gives no ratings.
The product spec PDF lists a mechanical thermostat and gives refrigerant R600a with 'Amount of Refrigerant 53' and no unit, so the charge is not recorded.
No interior lamp or lid switch is listed in the part list; that is not a stated absence, so those template parts are left alone.
method: Danby Diplomat 7.0 cu. ft. chest freezer: the Danby Appliance Parts page uses the Diplomat name, and danby.com's product page says the product has been discontinued.
Main source is Danby's own schematic / part list spreadsheet (XLSX, linked as 'Schematic / Part List' from the Danby Appliance Parts page): factory model BD1-200, effective date 9/9/2019, revision 0.
Part numbers, quantities and specification column read from the spreadsheet cells on 2026-11-12.
Ext/obs on extra parts are editorial.
